entities.name: Saint María of Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament

entities.summary: María Natividad Venegas de la Torre was a Mexican religious sister in the Roman Catholic Church. Torre founded the congregation of the Daughters of the Sacred Heart of Jesus of Guadalajara (Congregationem Sororum Filiarum Sacri Cordis Iesu) in 1930.
